Multiple platforms Our autonomous cars and delivery robots share the same innovative solutions, which we adapt to each platform, enabling them to learn from one another and continually improve. At your service Over 250 000 customers have already experienced the convenience, precision, and reliability of services powered by our autonomous technology. We are all about safety Our autonomous cars are designed to be safer than human drivers. With a 360-degree view, they never tire, get distracted, or break rules. Their experience spans more miles and data than any human could achieve, making roads safer for everyone. Proprietary hardware All our autonomous vehicles employ in-house hardware, customized to enhance our proprietary technology. Our lidars, cameras, computational hardware, and other components not only expand the capabilities of our autonomous driving system but also increase its redundancy. Analytics These cookies enable Avride to collect information about visits and traffic sources in order to assess and improve the performance of the website. They help us understand which pages are the most and least frequently visited and how visitors navigate through the website. If these cookies are disabled, Avride will be unable to determine when users have visited the website or to monitor its performance.
